purpose: Close Databento Rust adapter parity gaps by binding each inventory gap to fixture evidence, an explicit scope decision, or the later removal gate.

decisions.decision: Compact fixture coverage manifest now maps Databento DBN parser and live lifecycle surfaces to Rust fixtures and tests.
decisions.release_gate_note: Databento fixture traceability is no longer open for the R5 adapter parity gate.

decisions.decision: Databento remains a market-data adapter only; execution adapter parity is out of scope for this venue surface.
decisions.release_gate_note: Release notes must not claim Databento execution support.

decisions.decision: Databento live data remains dataset, publisher, and venue-map driven; this is an explicit configuration boundary rather than an adapter gap.
decisions.release_gate_note: Rust examples and docs must keep dataset and publisher mapping explicit.

decisions.decision: Granular unsubscribe and generic historical request behavior stay scoped to the Databento protocol and current request helpers.
decisions.release_gate_note: Release evidence must describe the supported request and subscription lifecycle instead of implying generic unsubscribe support.

decisions.decision: Historical book and bar support is limited to the selected DBN schemas already represented in the fixture manifest.
decisions.release_gate_note: Depth and bar aggregation support must remain documented as constrained.

decisions.decision: Databento imbalance, status, and statistics support covers modeled values; unsupported statistical values remain skipped by design.
decisions.release_gate_note: Skipped Databento statistical values stay a documented scope boundary.

decisions.decision: Optional Databento legacy bridge surfaces were removed by RREM-018 after this adapter parity task.
decisions.release_gate_note: RREM-018 closed this scoped Rust-only removal gate.
